ann.t: Intimation for Newspaper publication for unaudited financial result for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

Shalimar Productions Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026;
